scope: Recorded inputs and native outputs of 50 real UpperBodyServo calls (5 per active stage, LEFT 2->2 and RIGHT 4->4, seed 10000). CPU one-step equivalence only; not a physics claim.

left2.selection: Evenly spaced call ordinals including first/last; deterministic, no RNG
left2.excluded_scope: Stages without UpperBodyServo diagnostics are not solver calls and are not benchmarked

right4.selection: Evenly spaced call ordinals including first/last; deterministic, no RNG
right4.excluded_scope: Stages without UpperBodyServo diagnostics are not solver calls and are not benchmarked
